whyMatters.en: LA Armenian-American four-piece; Toxicity (2001) put odd meters, shouted politics, and abrupt dynamic cuts on nu-metal radio without hip-hop beds.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶亚美裔四人组；Toxicity（2001）把奇数拍、喊叫政治与突然动态切磋送上 nu-metal 电台，且无 hip-hop 铺底。

shortBio.en: Tankian / Malakian alt-metal; Chop Suey! is the 2001 structural spike.
shortBio.zh: Tankian / Malakian 的 alt-metal；Chop Suey! 是 2001 结构尖峰。

body.en:
Formed 1994 in LA. Self-titled debut and Toxicity fuse Tankian's theatrical vocal, Malakian's riff cuts, odd-time drums, and Middle Eastern melodic ornaments.

Chop Suey! (2001) is the citation—tempo and intensity change mid-song without a bridge cliché. They share early-2000s charts with Linkin Park but keep less hip-hop and more prog abruptness.
body.zh:
1994 年于 LA 组建。同名首专与 Toxicity 融合 Tankian 戏剧人声、Malakian riff 切割、奇数拍鼓与中东旋律装饰。

Chop Suey!（2001）是引用——曲中速度与强度切换，不靠俗套桥段。与 Linkin Park 共享 2000 年代初榜单，更少 hip-hop、更多 prog 式突然性。

note.en: Tempo flip mid-song; dual vocal without rap verse.
note.zh: 曲中速度翻转；双人声但无 rap 主歌。

note.en: Odd-meter main riff; title track anchors the album on rock radio.
note.zh: 奇数拍主 riff；标题曲把专辑钉在摇滚电台。

note.en: Mezmerize lead single; dance-punk jump and political chant.
note.zh: Mezmerize 主打； dance-punk 跳感与政治 chant。

body.en:
Toxicity (2001) lands SOAD on MTV and rock radio beside Linkin Park. Chop Suey! flips tempo and vocal register halfway; Aerials slows to a melodic chorus with Middle Eastern scale color.

Malakian's staccato riffs and Tankian's operatic shout define the four-piece—no DJ chair required.
body.zh:
Toxicity（2001）把 SOAD 送上 MTV 与摇滚电台，与 Linkin Park 并列。Chop Suey! 半途翻转速度与声区；Aerials 慢下来进旋律副歌，带中东音阶色彩。

Malakian 断奏 riff 与 Tankian 歌剧式喊叫定义四人组——无需 DJ 席。

body.en:
Tankian, Malakian, Odadjian, and Dolmayan are the only lineup on all five studio albums. Malakian shares vocal duty on later records; Tankian remains the primary face.

Hiatus gaps (2006–10, 2017–) split touring from recording; catalog peak is the 2001–05 four-piece.
body.zh:
Tankian、Malakian、Odadjian、Dolmayan 是五张 studio 专辑的唯一阵容。Malakian 后期分担人声；Tankian 仍是主面孔。

 hiatus 空档（2006–10、2017–）切开巡演与录音；目录峰值是 2001–05 四人组。

title.zh: Nu-metal 榜单里的 prog 突然性

body.en:
Slayer and Metallica sit in the thrash weight; Black Sabbath in the down-tuned chug. Tool shares festival bills; Linkin Park shares radio but stays hook-linear.

Influence is the mid-song structural cut—later alt-metal copies tempo flips more than Armenian lyrical themes.
body.zh:
Slayer 与 Metallica 在 thrash 重量里；Black Sabbath 在降调 chug 里。Tool 共享音乐节账单；Linkin Park 共享电台但更 hook 线性。

影响是曲中结构硬切——后期 alt-metal 多抄速度翻转，少抄亚美尼亚歌词主题。
